default: absent; ordinary schema-driven renderer selection applies, including automatic positional tuples and finite-array checkbox groups
effect: selects OTP for eligible password strings, tuple for eligible fixed arrays, chips or multi-select for their array-choice shapes, and AG Grid for arrays; it does not change the stored schema type
precedence: local UI variant drives tester or presentation selection; a flat config.variant does not select these renderers; multi-select and chips outrank automatic checkbox groups, while normal renderer ranking still applies to positional tuples and AG Grid; unsupported values do not request a specialized renderer, but schema-driven defaults remain eligible
